uncited: Dual Contouring preserves sharp features by using Hermite data (intersection points and surface normals) to minimize a Quadratic Error Function (QEF) for vertex placement [778-dual-contouring.md].

Surface Nets simplifies this by abandoning gradient data, using the weighted average of edge intersections for vertex placement, resulting in faster computation and smoother topology at the cost of geometric fidelity for sharp features [921-surface-nets.md].
